title: Query Logging and Performance
description: Monitor generated SQL queries, track execution durations, identify N+1 query patterns, and extract Prometheus metrics.

data.text: High-performance applications require deep visibility into the exact SQL statements generated by the ORM. Prisma provides structured event-based logging and built-in runtime metrics to diagnose slow queries, connection pool saturation, and query waterfalls.

data.title: Logging Queries with Duration Thresholds
data.content: Log every SQL query in development, and log only slow queries (>100ms) in staging/production.

data.text: Prisma includes a metrics API that captures query durations, connection pool wait times, and active client instances in Prometheus format or JSON.

data.title: Prometheus Metrics Endpoint in Next.js
Key Takeaways
points: Use `{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }` to capture query execution time.
Set alerts for queries taking longer than 100-200ms.
Use `prisma.$metrics.prometheus()` to feed metrics directly to Datadog or Prometheus.
